name: SignalPipe
description: Agentic sales pipeline — detects buying-intent signals on Reddit, HN, and RSS feeds, drafts outreach for Reddit and X/Twitter, and nurtures prospects from cold to closed. Requires SIGNALPIPE_API_URL and SIGNALPIPE_OPERATOR_KEY. humanInLoop: true — nothing sends without your approval.

apiUrl.description: SignalPipe backend URL — set via SIGNALPIPE_API_URL env var

operatorKey.description: SignalPipe operator key — set via SIGNALPIPE_OPERATOR_KEY env var
